title: A $\operatorname{prox}$-Based Semi-Smooth Newton Method for TV-Minimization
summary: In this paper, we devise a $\operatorname{prox}$-based semi-smooth Newton method for the non-differentiable TV-minimization problem. To this end, the primal-dual optimality conditions are reformulated as a nonlinear operator equation with Newton-(type-)differentiable structure. We investigate the question of well-posedness of the resulting semi-smooth Newton scheme in the infinite-dimensional setting and identify structural properties of the associated Newton-type derivatives.
